reference_predecessor.verification_scope: focused migration/retention pilot; not full v2 reconstruction acceptance

checks.title: Boot a v1 predecessor and migrate its real HTTP-created database
Preserve every v1 row and its live token/idempotency behavior
Migration leaves retention disabled and events visible
Repeated startup preserves migration data and version
New routes authenticate before lookup and reject unsupported methods
Reject malformed policies and invalid expiry limits without changing policy
Accept policy bounds, persist configuration and never delete implicitly
Age only disclosed synthetic v2 fixtures; restart and GET do not expire them
Delete only the oldest eligible event within the requested batch limit
Concurrent expiry batches serialize without double-counting
Keep recent, disabled-policy, other-inbox and longer-policy events
Release expired idempotency keys and deduplicate their replacement
Disabling retention survives restart and protects eligible data

reference_predecessor.migration_fixture: v1 predecessor creates data through HTTP; logical rows compared before fixture aging
reference_predecessor.expiry_fixture: only synthetic v2 events are backdated via SQLite while stopped; no elapsed-time claim
